title: Page 2
summary: Describes a CIA document (declassified, approved for release 2000) on site acquisition via a sealed envelope with geographic coordinates. The subject received the envelope before an interview and opened it afterward; it held a 3x5 card naming the planet Mars and a time of interest around 1 million years B.C. Coordinates were given verbally during the interview. The text ends with an alphanumeric code and page number 9.

title: Page 3
summary: A transcript from May 22, 1984 of a remote-viewing style session. The speaker is given coordinates (40.89 N, 9.55 W) and an envelope, describes a yellowish, okra-colored oblique pyramid-like form sitting in a large depressed area, then reports dust storms and a geologic event. Asked to revisit the time before it, they describe disappearing dirt mountains, large smooth flat surfaces, angles, walls, and megalithic structures, and are told to look for activity in the area before the geologic activity.

title: Page 4
summary: A transcript-like fragment from a declassified CIA document (Approved for Release 2000/08/08, CIA-RDP96-00788R001900760001-9) describing a remote-viewing style session. The subject reports shadowy, very tall thin then very large figures in strange clothing, fragmentary static-like perceptions, and is moved to coordinates 46.45 N, 353.22 E where they perceive a deep canyon with carved smooth-stone structures, high ceilings and wide walls resembling a rabbit warren of huge rooms. The session notes a time offset of real time plus 22 minutes and requests movement to a nearby location.

title: Page 5
summary: A document page marked as approved for release (CIA-RDP96-00788R001900760001-9) containing a transcribed remote-viewing session. It records coordinates (45.86N 354.1E, 35.26N 213.24E, 34.6N 213.09E) and the viewer's impressions: a Washington Monument-like obelisk at the end of a large road, a huge circular basin ringed by tall, ragged mountains, and a cluster of white, square, light-reflecting structures on the ground.

title: Page 6
summary: A declassified CIA document (RDP96-00788R001900760001-9) transcript of a remote-viewing session. The session monitor asks the subject to describe light-related perceptions and sun position, then directs movement to coordinates 34.57N 212.22E and later 15N 198E. The subject reports perceiving radiating patterns, intersecting deep roads or channels cut into valleys, rounded-bottom aqueduct-like channels, and sporadic focus problems, with the monitor urging refocusing.

title: Page 7
summary: A declassified CIA remote-viewing session transcript (MON/SUB exchange) describes a subject perceiving misty, distant terrain with pyramids that have interiors and exteriors, interpreted as storm shelters. Inside, chambers are bare and functional, apparently for sleeping or hibernating through savage storms. The monitor notes the subject is losing accuracy but is allowed to explore what interests him. Page header reads Approved For Release 2000/08/08 : CIA-RDP96-00788R001900760001-9.

title: Page 8
summary: A transcript excerpt of a remote-viewing style session in which the subject describes tall, thin, ancient people who sleep through storms, who are dying and philosophical about survival, and who are stuck, waiting for something to return. A group had gone a long way to find a new home because their environment was rapidly corrupting. The subject links the disturbance to a cosmic image of a globe passing through a comet's tail or river of space matter, with a warp, and the session ends with a request to ask the individual whether he knows anything. Includes CIA document release header and a voltage reversal note.

title: Page 9
summary: A declassified CIA document (Approved for Release 2000/08/08, CIA-RDP96-00788R001900760001-9) transcribes a 1984 hypnosis-style interview session. The subject describes perceiving a rounded, shiny-metal boat-like interior and then a volatile, volcanic place with gas pockets, dense vegetation, and a different kind of storm. The monitor guides the subject back to the present, to the voice and the date 22 May 1984, and the interview ends. Monitor comments not heard by the subject are noted.
